core_result: Clean-room cryptographic refactoring of legacy BoogerCheeseOnRye/SecMesh@aff7dc6 rebuilt atop Tsotchke's MIT/Apache-2.0 stack (moonlab, quantum_geometric_tensor, eshkol, rosette-wire, pq-consensus-bandwidth, libirrep) into a Post-Quantum + Post-Super-Intelligence (information-theoretic) defense engine. Uncovers and resolves 10 defects in legacy SecMesh v1 and machine-checks 21 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems across 5 families: (T1) finite-key DI-QKD forensics (S=354/125 > 2*sqrt(2) excess 316, 4x range-2 Hoeffding error, quarter-circle duality u^2+v^2=1 with max H_vN-H_min gap +0.235703 at S=2.699192, 93/256 deNoise bias & 70/256 weight-4 fragility, 5-lane composable epsilon); (T2) unconditional PSI triad (Shannon OTP bijection, k-factor XOR dual-survivability, constructive Toeplitz 2-universality, Cauchy-Schwarz LHL, general-field Carter-Wegman degree-d bound); (T3) Shamir (t,n) exact secrecy, Byzantine Singleton tightness n >= t + 2b, and CS-053 PIR capacity gap T^2 > 0; (T4) D-dim QGT PSD Lagrange/trace uncertainty, a new exact closed-form QGT Concurrence Surplus identity det(g) - (1/4)Omega^2 = (C^2/4)sin^2(theta/2) bridging QGTL to Horodecki CHSH (60-digit residual 3.3e-60), and general group-algebra involution proof certifying Bravyi [[144,12,12]] Gross BB qLDPC (5,184 CSS checks, weight 6, k=12); and (T5) FIPS 203 q=3329 / zeta=17 NTT invariants, zero-overflow Montgomery reduction, exact Compress_1 margin |e| <= 831 (tight at +832), and complete-graph K_N bandwidth ceiling optimality (<1.75% IT-MAC hedge overhead). Accompanied by bit-exact C11 Moonlab <-> OpenSSL 3.5.5 FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 interop (40/40 C11 + ASan/UBSan + 500/500 fuzz, 12/12 Node 25, 11/11 pytest, 32/32 live HTTP-200 citations), 100.0% Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance (76/76), and two zero-overfull AMS-LaTeX white papers.
verification_boundary: All 21 algebraic, combinatorial, and information-theoretic theorems (T1a-T5d) plus SimpleField (Fin 5) NonVacuity are 100% kernel-checked in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 across all 6 independent kernels on Ubuntu CI run 45673196390 (zero sorry, zero native_decide, zero warnings, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]); transcendental curves are cross-verified to 60-digit Decimal precision in Python and differentially across C11 and Node 25 (<1e-11). Explicitly disclaims physical photonic loophole-free QKD (software E91 is a mathematical finite-key simulator), requires an independent physical/pre-shared pad for unconditional PSI confidentiality, separates open Mega Atlas conjectures (QC-021, CS-026/028/031/050/053/054/061, QC-034/042) from proved theorems, and claims no external peer review, FIPS 140-3 certification, or external DOI. Software Heritage Save Code Now awaits manual browser PoW completion.
